title: UPDATE: SpaceX and Salesforce Replace AI Branding With ‘Super Intelligence’

tickers.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
SpaceXAI has adopted the name SpaceX Super Intelligence in its public branding, API documentation and brand guidelines, following Elon Musk’s Oct. 4 pledge to make the change. Salesforce renamed AIForce to SIForce on Oct. 9, while Tesla AI has become Tesla SI.

Microsoft Chief Executive Officer Satya Nadella and Nvidia have also adopted the term “super intelligence.” SpaceX’s branding change leaves Grok as the product name.

The changes follow President Donald Trump’s Sept. 29 executive order requiring federal agencies to replace “Artificial Intelligence” and “AI” with “Super Intelligence” and “SI” in official communications, to the maximum extent permitted by law. Trump escalated his push on Oct. 8, declaring those using the old term “THE ENEMY!” California Governor Gavin Newsom has directed state agencies to continue using “artificial intelligence.”

California Gov. Gavin Newsom signed an executive order today (30 sep) declaring that Artificial Intelligence will be called "Artificial Intelligence" in California.

> Employers can't use AI to read workers' emotions. AB 1883 bans AI surveillance tools that recognize or predict an employee's emotional state, or that collect neural data, such as readings from brain or nervous system sensors. 

> AI can't make firing decisions alone, and AI layoffs must be disclosed. Employers can't rely only on AI for discipline or termination. They must also tell workers if a mass layoff, relocation, or termination is caused by an AI system. 

> The wider package goes beyond the workplace. It protects doctors' own judgment when clinical AI tools are used, bans deleting AI watermarks, strengthens likeness protections against deepfakes, and requires gene synthesis companies to verify their customers and screen what they ship.
